name: Json To TypeScript
description: Convert JSON to TypeScript - Generate interface or type from JSON. Type Inference - Detect string, number, boolean, array, and nested objects. Validation - Check if the input is valid JSON before conversion. Formatting & Prettify - Properly format and indent the output. Download as File - Allow users to export TypeScript code as a .ts file. Dark/Light Mode - Optional UI enhancement. Copy to Clipboard - Quick copy button for easy access.
